petPolicy: Hotel Ville d'Hiver sits in the leafy Belle Epoque Ville d'Hiver district beside the Parc Mauresque, and welcomes dogs of any size completely free of charge. There is no weight limit and no extra fee. Cats are also accepted on request. The hotel has a heated outdoor pool, a quiet garden, and is a short leashed walk from the Parc Mauresque trails and the seafront. Pets must be kept on a lead in common areas and are not permitted in the breakfast room or pool area. Please mention your pet at the time of booking so a suitable room can be allocated.

name: Les Vagues Hotel & Spa
petPolicy: Les Vagues is a five-star seafront hotel on the bay promenade with direct access to Plage Thiers and Plage Pereire, a Phytomer spa, and a panoramic rooftop. Pets are welcome for a small nightly fee and the hotel provides pet bowls and a pet basket on request. The calm bay beaches in front of the hotel are open to leashed dogs off-season (October to May). Pets must be leashed in all common areas and are not permitted in the spa, the restaurant, or the pool. Confirm your pet and the current fee at the time of booking.
highlights: Direct access to the bay beach

name: Grand Hotel Richelieu
petPolicy: The Grand Hotel Richelieu sits on the Arcachon seafront in the Ville d'Ete, with direct access to the beach and sea-view rooms a short walk from the Jetee Thiers and the town centre. Dogs and cats are welcome for a small nightly fee. The hotel offers free parking and free WiFi. Pets are allowed in the rooms and common areas on a lead but not in the breakfast room, so plan an al fresco breakfast on warm mornings. The seafront promenade outside the door is ideal for early dog walks. Declare your pet when booking to confirm the current fee.

name: Best Western Arcachon Le Port
petPolicy: Best Western Arcachon Le Port faces the marina in the heart of Arcachon, a few minutes from the SNCF station, the Halles market, and the seafront. Dogs up to 10 kg are warmly welcomed for 12 EUR per pet per night. Cats are also accepted. Pets are allowed in the rooms and common areas on a lead but are not permitted in the dining room during breakfast. The central location makes leashed walks to the promenade and the port quays easy. Mention your pet at booking to secure a suitable room.
highlights: Walk to SNCF station and Halles

name: Hotel Le Dauphin
petPolicy: Hotel Le Dauphin is a characterful Belle Epoque villa hotel in the Ville d'Hiver, set in a garden a short leashed walk from the Parc Mauresque and the lift down to the seafront. Dogs and cats are welcome for a small nightly fee; guests should bring a lead, a bed or blanket, and any food for the stay. Pets are allowed in the rooms and the garden on a lead but not in the breakfast area. The quiet residential streets of the Ville d'Hiver are pleasant for morning walks among the historic villas. Confirm your pet and the fee at the time of booking.

petPolicy: Dogs are welcome at this 5-star Christian Lacroix-designed MGallery palace for EUR 13 per dog per night, charged at check-in. The hotel does not accept cats. The Jardin d'Ete park and the Arles arenes are both within a 5-minute leashed walk.

petPolicy: Pets are welcome on request at this Cuban artist Jorge Pardo-designed boutique 5-star for around EUR 20 per night. The property's private courtyard offers a sheltered spot for a quick break before walks along the Rhone.

petPolicy: Pets are accepted on request at this 18th-century private mansion in the Roquette district for around EUR 25 per night, with advance notice required at booking. Designated pet-friendly rooms are reserved on a request basis, so declare your pet at booking. The hotel also offers fully accessible facilities throughout.
highlights: Pets welcome on request, €30 per night
100 m from San Mamés metro, easy Guggenheim access

Os quartos pet-friendly estão reservados a pedido, por isso indique o seu animal na reserva. O hotel oferece também instalações totalmente acessíveis.

name: Ibis Bilbao Centro
petPolicy: Ibis Bilbao Centro accepts pets of any size for an additional fee of €7 per pet, per night, one of the most affordable pet fees of any hotel in Bilbao. The hotel is well-located in the city centre with easy access to the tram network for dog-friendly travel across Bilbao. Please notify the hotel in advance that you are bringing a pet.

name: Petit Palace Arana Bilbao
petPolicy: Petit Palace Arana Bilbao is a boutique 3-star hotel set in an impressive 19th-century building at the entrance to the Casco Viejo, overlooking the Arriaga Theatre. Pets of any size are welcome in designated rooms for a supplement of around €25 per pet, per night. The hotel provides a pet bed, bowl and food on arrival. Free bicycles are available for guests, and the Guggenheim is a 20-minute walk away. Notify the hotel of your pet at booking.
highlights: Pets welcome in designated rooms, pet bed and bowl provided
Free bicycles, 20 min walk to the Guggenheim
petPolicyPt: O Petit Palace Arana Bilbao é um hotel boutique de 3 estrelas instalado num edifício do século XIX à entrada do Casco Viejo, em frente ao Teatro Arriaga. Animais de qualquer tamanho são bem-vindos em quartos designados por um suplemento de cerca de €25 por animal por noite. O hotel oferece cama, taça e comida para o animal à chegada. Há bicicletas gratuitas para os hóspedes e o Guggenheim fica a 20 minutos a pé. Indique o seu animal no momento da reserva.

name: Hotel Park
petPolicy: Hotel Park (Sava Hotels & Resorts) welcomes well-behaved pets in designated rooms for a fee of 35 EUR per pet per night, as published on the official Sava Hotels site. Pets are not permitted in the hotel restaurant, bar or Spa Park. Both dogs and cats are accepted. Bowls and a brief Bled dog-walking guide are typically provided on request. Lake-view rooms face directly onto Bled Island and the famous Park Cafe kremsnita terrace is right downstairs.

name: Hotel Triglav Bled
petPolicy: Hotel Triglav Bled is one of the most genuinely pet-welcoming hotels at the lake. Pets of any size are accepted in designated pet-friendly rooms for 20 EUR per pet per night, both dogs and cats. The hotel provides a welcome amenity of dog biscuits and a bowl in the room, and staff are noted by guests for being especially warm with arriving dogs. Located on the quiet Bled Jezero end of the lake, just above the train station, with direct lake-circuit access.

name: Hotel Lovec
petPolicy: Hotel Lovec accepts well-behaved pets on request for a fee of approximately 25 EUR per night, charged at check-in. Both dogs and cats are welcomed in designated rooms. The hotel is in the centre of Bled village, 200 m from the lakeshore, putting the lake circuit, castle walk-up and main village restaurants all within an easy on-leash stroll. Declare your pet at booking to secure pet-friendly room allocation.

name: Bled Rose Hotel
petPolicy: Bled Rose Hotel (formerly Hotel Jelovica) accepts dogs and cats on request for around 15 EUR per night. One pet per room, maximum dog weight 10 kg. Located in the heart of Bled village near the bus station, 5 to 7 minutes on foot to the lakeshore promenade. Notify the hotel at booking that you are travelling with a pet.

name: Hotel Krim Bled
petPolicy: Hotel Krim is a friendly 3-star option in the centre of Bled with the most affordable pet policy in the village, around 7 EUR per pet per night on request, both dogs and cats accepted. A simple, well-located base for active travellers spending most of their day on the lake circuit, Triglav National Park trails or Vintgar Gorge. Confirm the pet at booking.

name: Parkhotel Laurin
petPolicy: Parkhotel Laurin is a historic Art Nouveau hotel from 1910 in the heart of Bolzano, 200 m from the cathedral. Dogs are welcome on request with a pet fee of approximately €25 per night charged at check-in. Pets are not permitted in the restaurant or pool area, but the hotel's private 5,000 m² garden adjoins the room wing and is the perfect place for a quiet walk. Please declare your pet at booking; cats are accepted only by prior agreement.
highlights: 200 m from cathedral and Piazza Walther

name: Hotel Greif, a Member of Design Hotels
petPolicy: Hotel Greif is a design hotel on Piazza Walther in the heart of Bolzano's Altstadt, each room individually designed by contemporary artists. One dog per room is welcome with a fee of approximately €25 per night. Cats are not accepted. Pets are welcome in the rooms and lobby but not in the restaurant. Designer rooms come with dedicated pet bowls and a welcome treat.

name: Stadt Hotel Città
petPolicy: Stadt Hotel Città sits on Piazza Walther, with arcade-facing rooms overlooking the main square. One pet per room is allowed free of charge. Both dogs and cats are accepted. Pets are not allowed in the breakfast area or restaurant, but the hotel provides a pet basket and food/water bowls on request. The Talferwiesen river meadows are 8 minutes' walk away.
highlights: Pet basket and bowls provided on request

name: Four Points by Sheraton Bolzano
petPolicy: Four Points by Sheraton Bolzano is a modern business-friendly hotel just south of the centre near the Fiera trade fair. Two pets of any size are welcome per room for a fee of approximately €50 per stay (not per night). Both dogs and cats are accepted. Pets are allowed in public areas except the restaurants. A welcome kit with food and water bowls is provided.
highlights: Free parking and easy A22 motorway access

name: B&B Hotel Bolzano
petPolicy: B&B Hotel Bolzano is the budget pet-friendly choice in the city, with modern functional rooms and 24-hour reception. Pets of any size are welcome for a modest fee of approximately €5 per pet per night. Both dogs and cats are accepted. Pets must be leashed in common areas and are not allowed unattended in rooms. The Talvera river meadows are a 15-minute walk away.

name: Kameha Grand Bonn
petPolicy: Kameha Grand Bonn welcomes dogs of any size for an additional €35 per dog per night (cats are not allowed). Dogs are permitted in guest rooms and across the public areas except the spa, pool and breakfast restaurant. Pet beds, food and water bowls are available on request. The hotel sits directly on the Rhine in the federal Bundesviertel district, with a 5-minute walk to the riverside promenade and 10 minutes to the Rheinaue park.
highlights: Direct Rhine river views from many rooms
Walk to Rheinaue 160-hectare park in 10 minutes
Pet beds and bowls on request

name: AMERON Bonn Hotel Königshof
petPolicy: AMERON Bonn Hotel Königshof welcomes dogs in guest rooms for €20 per dog per night, with welcome treats, a dog bed and feeding bowls provided. Dogs are not allowed in restaurant Oliveto but are welcome on the Rhine-facing terrace and in the lobby bar. The hotel overlooks the Rhine on Adenauerallee, a 5-minute walk from the Altstadt and Beethoven-Haus, with direct access to the Rheinufer promenade.
highlights: Welcome dog bed, bowls and treats included
5 minutes' walk to Altstadt and Beethoven-Haus

name: Hotel Collegium Leoninum
petPolicy: Hotel Collegium Leoninum welcomes cats and dogs (limit 2 per room) for €15 per pet per night, with a dog bed, water and food bowls, plus a treat on arrival. Pets are not permitted in the indoor pool, sauna and breakfast room but are welcome in all guest rooms and the lobby. Set in a converted 19th-century seminary in the Altstadt, 8 minutes' walk from the Beethoven-Haus and the Rhine.
highlights: Up to 2 pets per room, full welcome kit
Indoor pool, sauna and gym (no pets in spa)

name: Hotel Deutsches Haus
petPolicy: Hotel Deutsches Haus welcomes dogs of any size free of charge - no additional pet fee is applied. Multiple pets are accepted on request. petPolicy: The Verb Hotel allows pets up to 25 lbs in designated pet-friendly rooms for a fee of approximately USD 75 per stay. Music-themed boutique hotel 200 m from Fenway Park, with outdoor pool and free WiFi, in the Fenway-Kenmore neighborhood. Please confirm with the property when booking.
highlights: Pet fee €70 as listed on Booking

name: The Whitney Hotel Boston
petPolicy: The Whitney Hotel Boston is listed among Booking.com's most popular pet-friendly hotels in Boston. 5-star boutique property at the foot of Beacon Hill near the Charles River Esplanade, with shared lounge, fitness centre and free bikes. Pets accepted on request; confirm size limits and any fees at booking. Please confirm with the property when booking.

name: The Colonnade Hotel
petPolicy: The Colonnade Hotel runs a VIPets program with no pet fee for dogs up to 75 lbs, offering pet beds, bowls and treats on arrival. Independent 4-star hotel in the Back Bay with seasonal rooftop pool, walking distance from Copley Square and Prudential Center. Please confirm with the property when booking.

petPolicy: Hilton Boston Downtown/Faneuil Hall is listed on Booking.com as pet-friendly under Hilton's brand pet policy (dogs up to 75 lbs, fee typically USD 75 per stay). highlights: Pet fee €70 as listed on Booking

name: B&B Hotel Boulogne-sur-Mer
petPolicy: B&B Hotel Boulogne-sur-Mer is listed on Booking.com as pet-friendly; pets of any size accepted for EUR 4 per pet per night, one of the most affordable pet fees in the area. Please confirm with the property when booking.

name: Hotel La Matelote
petPolicy: Hotel La Matelote is listed on Booking.com as pet-friendly with charm and seaside location opposite Nausicaa aquarium. Refined boutique 4-star with restaurant. Please confirm with the property when booking.

name: Ibis Styles Boulogne-sur-Mer Centre Cathedrale
petPolicy: Ibis Styles Boulogne-sur-Mer Centre Cathedrale is listed on Booking.com as pet-friendly; pets accepted for approximately EUR 10 per night per Accor group standard. Central location near the cathedral and old town. Please confirm with the property when booking.

name: Hotel Atlantic Wimereux
petPolicy: Hotel Atlantic Wimereux is listed on Booking.com as pet-friendly. Seafront 4-star hotel in Wimereux just north of Boulogne, with beach access on the Opal Coast. Please confirm with the property when booking.

name: Kyriad Boulogne-sur-Mer
petPolicy: Kyriad Boulogne-sur-Mer is listed on Booking.com as pet-friendly; pets accepted per Kyriad chain standard policy. Convenient location near the port. Please confirm with the property when booking.

name: Hotel Miramar Bournemouth
petPolicy: Hotel Miramar welcomes well-behaved dogs of any size for £15 per pet per night, with cats accepted on request. The 1925 cliff-top hotel sits opposite the gardens and a 2-minute walk to the central beach (winter dog zone). Water bowls in the lounge.
highlights: Two-minute walk to gardens and beach lift

name: Marsham Court Hotel
petPolicy: Marsham Court welcomes pets in designated ground-floor rooms for £12 per pet per night. Dogs and cats both accepted. The hotel sits on the East Cliff with a heated outdoor pool and a five-minute walk down the zig-zag path to the pier and central beach.
highlights: East Cliff location with sea views

name: The Suncliff Hotel
petPolicy: The Suncliff welcomes dogs and cats in selected rooms for £10 per pet per night. The Britannia hotel occupies a cliff-top position on the East Cliff with direct lift access to the Boscombe seafront promenade and the year-round dog beach east of Boscombe Pier.
highlights: Cliff-top with direct lift to beach
Five minutes from Boscombe dog beach

name: Carlton Hotel Bournemouth
petPolicy: The Carlton accepts dogs of any size for £30 per pet per night, with cats by prior arrangement. The Edwardian property on the East Overcliff Drive provides dog beds and water bowls on request, and overlooks the sea with garden access for morning walks.
highlights: Dog bed and welcome treats on request

name: Premier Inn Bournemouth Central
petPolicy: Premier Inn Bournemouth Central admits up to two dogs per room (cats not accepted) for a one-off £25 charge per stay (not per night). The central location is a 10-minute walk to the beach and the gardens, with the Hengistbury Head bus stop one street away.
highlights: Flat one-off £25 pet fee per stay
Hengistbury bus stop one street away

name: Vila Galé Collection Braga
petPolicy: Vila Galé Collection Braga welcomes pets in a converted 18th-century hospital in the historic centre. A pet fee of €15 per night per pet applies, with one pet per room (max 10 kg). Dogs must be on a lead in all common areas and are not permitted in the spa, indoor pool or restaurant. The hotel provides a welcome bed and bowl on request. Declare your pet at the time of booking.

name: Melia Braga Hotel & Spa
petPolicy: Melia Braga Hotel & Spa accepts small pets up to 10 kg, with a fee of €20 per night per pet. Pets must remain on a lead in lobby and corridors and are not permitted in dining areas, the spa or the pool. The hotel is set in a residential district with quiet green space at the door, useful for early-morning walks. Confirm pet booking by email after reservation.

name: Hotel do Templo
petPolicy: Hotel do Templo welcomes pets up to 15 kg with a fee of €10 per night per pet. Located steps from the Bom Jesus do Monte staircase and surrounding forest, the location is ideal for dogs needing space. Pets must be on a lead in common areas and are not permitted in the restaurant. Please declare your pet at booking.
highlights: Steps from Bom Jesus do Monte

name: Burgus Tribute & Design Hotel
petPolicy: Burgus Tribute & Design Hotel welcomes small pets (under 8 kg) at no additional charge in standard rooms. Pets must be on a lead in all common areas and are not permitted in the breakfast room or terrace bar. The boutique hotel occupies a restored townhouse on Avenida Central, walking distance to all major sights.
highlights: No pet fee for small dogs

name: Hotel Mercure Braga Centro
petPolicy: Hotel Mercure Braga Centro accepts pets up to 10 kg with a fee of €12 per night per pet. The hotel sits one block from Parque da Ponte and is convenient for early-morning walks. Pets are allowed in the room and common areas on a lead, but not in the restaurant or breakfast service area. Please declare your pet at the time of booking.

name: Hotel Aro Palace
petPolicy: Hotel Aro Palace welcomes pets in the historic 1939 landmark hotel on Bulevardul Eroilor, a five-minute walk from Piața Sfatului. A pet fee of €25 per night applies; small to medium pets are accepted (max 15 kg, one per room). Pets must be kept on lead in all common areas and are not permitted in the restaurant, spa or indoor pool. Declare your pet at the time of booking.

name: Hotel Kronwell Brașov
petPolicy: Hotel Kronwell Brașov accepts pets in its contemporary design hotel in the Centrul Civic district, 10 minutes' walk from the old town. A pet fee of €20 per night per pet applies, with one pet up to 10 kg per room. Pets must be kept on lead in lobbies and corridors and are not permitted in the restaurant or spa areas. Declare your pet at the time of booking.

name: Casa Wagner
petPolicy: Casa Wagner is a 16th-century Saxon merchant townhouse on Piața Sfatului, lovingly restored as a boutique hotel. Pets are accepted for a fee of €15 per night per pet (max 10 kg). Pets must be kept on lead in all common areas and are not permitted in the breakfast room. The team can recommend dog walkers and dog-friendly hiking routes on Tâmpa. Declare your pet at booking.
highlights: Historic Saxon townhouse on Piața Sfatului

name: Hotel Bella Muzica
petPolicy: Hotel Bella Muzica occupies a 16th-century building on Piața Sfatului with a Mexican-Romanian fusion restaurant in a vaulted cellar. Pets up to 10 kg are accepted for a fee of €15 per night. Pets are welcome in rooms and on lead in lobbies; the cellar restaurant is reserved for guests without pets due to the confined space.
